name: Fixed ladders, safety cages and fall-arrest rails
description: Vertical and inclined fixed ladders give access between decks and to structures. Above a threshold height they need a cage or a fall-arrest rail, with a landing gate at every opening.

gaps.what: Ladder geometry, cage dimensions and load class
gaps.why: No page read gives ladder geometry, cage dimensions or the design load class.
gaps.next_action: Fetch ISO 14122-4 or a platform GA and record rung spacing, cage dimensions and load class
